item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Issued at 12:30 PM 11 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Sorsogon(Matnog, Bulan, Irosin, SantaMagdalena, Bulusan, CityOfSorsogon, PrietoDiaz, Pilar, Donsol), #Albay(Manito, Guinobatan, PioDuran, Jovellar, CityOfTabaco, Polangui, Libon, Oas, Tiwi, CityOfLigao, Malinao), #CamarinesSur(Buhi, Sagñay, Tigaon, SanJose, IrigaCity, Garchitorena, Caramoan), #Masbate(SanPascual, Claveria), #NorthernSamar(LasNavas, Catubig, Palapag, Gamay, Lapinig and Mapanas) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NorthernSamar(Catarman, Bobon, SanJose, Rosario, Lavezares, Allen, Victoria, SanIsidro, LopeDeVega, SanAntonio, Capul, SanVicente, Biri, Mondragon, SilvinoLobos, SanRoque, Pambujan, Laoang), #Sorsogon(Magallanes, Juban, Casiguran, Barcelona, Gubat, Castilla), #Albay(LegazpiCity, Daraga, Camalig, Malilipot, Bacacay, SantoDomingo), #CamarinesSur(Lagonoy, Presentacion and Goa) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
